scripts.test:unit: bash -lc 'shopt -s globstar nullglob; files=(src/**/*.test.mjs scripts/**/*.test.mjs); if [ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No JS tests — skipping"; exit 0; fi; node --test "${files[@]}"'
scripts.test:unit:coverage: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; shopt -s globstar nullglob; files=(src/**/*.test.mjs scripts/**/*.test.mjs); if [ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No JS tests — skipping"; exit 0; fi; npx c8 --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary --reporter=json-summary --reporter=lcov --include "src/**/*.mjs" --exclude "src/**/*.test.mjs" --exclude "src/game/test-hooks.mjs" --report-dir=coverage-report-unit --check-coverage --lines=90 --statements=90 --functions=90 --branches=85 node --test "${files[@]}"; npm run coverage:check:unit'
